intro: Paraguay exports soya, beef and huge amounts of clean electricity.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Paraguay is a top soya and beef exporter. Almost all its electricity comes from hydropower, and it sells the surplus to Brazil and Argentina.

chapters.title: River fleet
text: Paraguay has one of the largest river barge fleets in the world.
